2607.27178.title: DenseOn with the LateOn: Fully Open Dense and Late-Interaction Models for Multilingual, Long-Context, and Code Search
2607.27178.paper_summary: State-of-the-art retrieval models increasingly rely on closed training data, creating a reproducibility gap. We present an open end-to-end recipe for training retrieval models and study how English supervision transfers to multilingual retrieval through translate-train. We first reconstruct and curate 665M English contrastive pre-training pairs from 1.4B pairs across 34 public sources and build 1.88M supervised fine-tuning pairs with mined hard negatives. Training yields two 149M-parameter models: DenseOn, a single-vector dense model, and LateOn, a ColBERT-style late-interaction model. They achieve 56.20 and 57.22 average nDCG@10 on BEIR, respectively, setting new state-of-the-art results for this size class. We then translate the validated English data into eight languages, yielding 2.8B pairs with cross-lingual samples, and train mDenseOn and mLateOn, two 307M-parameter models built on mmBERT-base. Despite sharing their backbone, data, and objectives, their representations behave differently: the dense model is strong on English and translated languages but degrades outside translate-train support, whereas the late-interaction model generalizes better to unseen languages and scripts. This suggests that token-level matching turns translate-train from a target-language expansion strategy into a multilingual generalization recipe. We publicly release the models, datasets, and training code.
2607.27178.paper_summary_zh: 最先進的檢索模型越來越依賴封閉的訓練數據，造成可重現性差距。<lb/>我們提出了一個開放的端到端檢索模型訓練配方，並研究英語監督如何通過翻譯訓練轉移到多語言檢索。<lb/>我們首先從34個公共來源的14億對中重建並整理了6.65億英語對比預訓練對，並構建了188萬個帶有挖掘困難負樣本的監督微調對。<lb/>訓練產生了兩個149M參數的模型：DenseOn，一個單向量密集模型，以及LateOn，一個ColBERT風格的晚互動模型。<lb/>它們在BEIR上分別達到了56.20和57.22的平均nDCG@10，為這一尺寸級別設定了新的最先進結果。<lb/>然後，我們將經過驗證的英語數據翻譯成八種語言，產生了28億對帶有跨語言樣本的數據，並訓練了mDenseOn和mLateOn，這兩個307M參數的模型基於mmBERT-base。<lb/>儘管共享它們的骨幹、數據和目標，但它們的表示行為卻不同：密集模型在英語和翻譯語言上表現強勁，但在翻譯訓練支持之外會下降，而晚互動模型對未見過的語言和字母系統的泛化能力更強。<lb/>這表明，基於標記的匹配將翻譯訓練從一種目標語言擴展策略轉變為一種多語言泛化配方。<lb/>我們公開發布這些模型、數據集和訓練代碼。
